candidates.evidence: Two bands at 379.9 and 404.4 cm-1 (FWHM about 8 cm-1) with separation 24.5 cm-1. These match the E2g1 and A1g modes of MoS2, which are literature-known near 383 and 408 cm-1 for bulk. The separation fits thicker-than-monolayer films (Lee et al. 2010: monolayer about 19 cm-1, bulk about 25 cm-1). Both bands sit about 3-4 cm-1 low versus bulk, so calibration, heating or strain is possible. Only two main bands lie in the 350-451 window, and the other MoS2 modes (E1 2g near 286, 1LA(M) near 227) are outside it, so the identification rests on the pair alone.
Rejected. WS2 has E2g near 355 and A1g near 418 cm-1, a separation of about 63 cm-1. The data have no band near 355 and the separation is about 24 cm-1.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given (material_hint null), so this is an identify task. The analysis supports 2H-MoS2 as the most likely material, with the caveats below.

peaks.source: Position and FWHM from a 3-peak pseudo-Voigt fit of 355-445 cm-1 (position stderr 0.08). Assignment from Lee et al. 2010, ACS Nano 4, 2695, doi:10.1021/nn1003937 (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20392077/; arXiv https://arxiv.org/abs/1005.2509). Bulk value near 382-383 cm-1 in that work; observed position is about 3 cm-1 lower.

Position and FWHM from the same 3-peak fit (position stderr 0.06). Assignment from Lee et al. 2010 (doi:10.1021/nn1003937; https://arxiv.org/abs/1005.2509). Bulk value near 407-408 cm-1 in that work; observed position is about 3-4 cm-1 lower.

peaks.assignment: unassigned weak shoulder (about 9 % of A1g amplitude; appears only in the 3-peak fit, position stderr 0.70)

properties.name: phase
properties.source: Band positions and separation match 2H-MoS2 E2g1/A1g pair; the 1T-type J modes that would indicate another phase are absent in the 350-451 window. Lee et al. 2010 (doi:10.1021/nn1003937).

properties.name: layers
properties.value: more than one layer; thick or bulk-like, exact count not determined
properties.source: Separation 24.5 cm-1 (fit: 24.45-24.7 depending on model). Lee et al. 2010 gives roughly 19 cm-1 for a monolayer and about 25 cm-1 for bulk, approximate values quoted from the paper's trend, not re-read from its numeric table. The bands are not resolved enough to fix N.

properties.name: defect_level
properties.source: A broad line (FWHM about 8 cm-1) is consistent with reduced crystallinity or non-uniformity of ALD-grown films, but no defect relation was applied and no defect-activated band (for example the D-like band near 230-250 cm-1) is in the window.

citations: Lee, C. et al. Anomalous lattice vibrations of single- and few-layer MoS2. ACS Nano 4, 2695-2700 (2010). doi:10.1021/nn1003937. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20392077/ ; arXiv:1005.2509 https://arxiv.org/abs/1005.2509 (Fig. 2 shows E2g and A1g frequencies and their difference versus layer number).
limits: Calibration is not checked. The Si 520.7 cm-1 line is outside the 350-451 cm-1 window, so absolute shifts carry about 1-2 cm-1 uncertainty. Both modes sit about 3-4 cm-1 below typical bulk values (E2g 382-383, A1g 407-408); calibration offset, laser heating, strain or doping could explain this. They cannot be separated from one spectrum.

Only the two main bands are present in the window. The low-frequency modes (1LA(M) near 227, E1 2g near 286) and the 2LA(M) band near 450 cm-1 are outside it or at the edge; the 445-450 cm-1 data show no clear band above noise (about 0.006). Identification therefore rests on the pair position and separation, not on a full fingerprint.
The weak 412 cm-1 shoulder is supported only by the 3-peak fit. It has about 9 % of the A1g amplitude and is not assigned. It may be an artefact of line shape.
Layer number is qualitative only. A separation of 24.5 cm-1 says the film is thicker than a monolayer, but no exact count is given. Thickness nonuniformity across the spot is not excluded.

No polarization data (single spectrum), laser wavelength or temperature were supplied. Resonance enhancement, 2nd-order bands and selection rules could not be checked, so the irreps are bulk-D6h labels by default.

The skill's scripts (rl_qc, rl_fit, rl.py match_library, reference relations and notes) live outside the working folder and were not run or read, per the folder restriction. Fitting was done with my own script in ./analysis/. Candidate ranking was done by comparing positions with the literature, not with the Computational Raman Database matcher. Layer-number thresholds are from memory of Lee et al. 2010, cited above, and should be checked against its numeric table.

ALD-grown MoS2 films are often amorphous or nanocrystalline. The sharp-ish bands (FWHM about 8 cm-1) suggest a crystalline or partly crystalline film, but the data cannot establish its phase purity. Other sulfides with bands in this range (for example 1T-MoS2) are not fully excluded because their diagnostic bands fall outside the window; they are disfavoured by the observed separation.
No cosmic-ray spikes or saturation were seen by inspection of the data. The maximum is 1.0 (normalized) at 404.3 cm-1, with noise sigma about 0.006.
